title: RESOLUTE Wire
dek: National, global, and tech briefing for citizens and pastors. Civic week lives on RESOLUTE Local.
disclosure: AI news desk for USMC Ministries / RESOLUTE. Human-approved before public. Not Associated Press. Links out to sources; short insights are fair-use commentary, not full reprints.

desks.product: RESOLUTE Wire · Sunday AM national/tech refresh

lead.hed: USNI: USS Benfold sat four days without power in the South China Sea
lead.insight: USNI, updated overnight: guided-missile destroyer Benfold (DDG-65) lost power and drifted four days in the South China Sea. Seventh Fleet confirmed the casualty; the update says she was towed to Subic Bay. Readiness story — not a combat report.
lead.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 9678705 · VIRIN 260409-N-SR235-4910 · PUBLIC DOMAIN
lead.image_note: Benfold PD still already on disk. Do not reuse DVIDS 768415 SM-3 Fitzgerald hero.

political.hed: USNI: White House memo floats foreign-built warships
political.insight: Aug 13 presidential memo, as reported by USNI: Pentagon to consider foreign-built warships and auxiliaries, plus steam catapults on future Ford-class carriers. Memo is direction. Watch Congress and the yards, not the headline alone.
political.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 9615140 · VIRIN 260412-N-GC805-1028 · PUBLIC DOMAIN

political.hed: WORLD: Trump’s Ukraine posture shifts with the battlefield
political.insight: WORLD (Aug 13) frames a U-turn: more public backing for Kyiv after battlefield gains. Reporting, not a treaty. Stockpile math still sits under the photo-ops — see the Patriot-license Watch item.
political.image_note: No public-domain still. Leave blank — do not use a brand tile.

political.hed: Heritage: take the White House higher-ed compact to the states
political.insight: Heritage (Aug 13) argues the federal Compact for Academic Excellence should now be applied in state policy as the school year starts. Advocacy analysis — track actual state bills and university sign-ons, not the culture-war caption.

tech.hed: OpenAI: Ultrafast runs GPT-5.6 Sol up to 14× on Cerebras
tech.insight: OpenAI’s own post: a new API tier, powered by Cerebras, claims up to 750 output tokens per second and up to 14× Standard. Vendor preview — no public price and no general date in the text. Speed claim, not a new model.

tech.hed: Anthropic: Claude text will carry a SynthID-style watermark
tech.insight: Anthropic says future Claude models will watermark generated text to meet the EU AI Act. Method is a SynthID-Text approach; they say it does not change readable quality and cannot be traced to a person or chat. Policy mark, not a detector you can run at home.

tech.hed: Pentagon locks Boeing and RTX into seven years of SM-3 parts
tech.insight: Friday framework deals, per Defense News and a matching Department of War release: SM-3 Block IB and IIA avionics and ejector assemblies. No dollar figure and no quantity in either text. Yesterday’s hero — industrial tempo, not today’s lead.
tech.image_credit: U.S. Navy / DVIDS 768415 · VIRIN 121025-N-ZZ999-001 · PUBLIC DOMAIN

watch.hed: WATCH: Patriot makers hedge on the Ukraine production license
watch.insight: Defense News from Kyiv: Trump pledged a Patriot-interceptor license last month; Lockheed and Raytheon are talking about what is feasible. Promise is not a factory. Pin until a signed license or a first kit exists.

watch.hed: WATCH: Hassabis becomes DeepMind chair; Kavukcuoglu takes the ops seat
watch.insight: Sundar Pichai’s staff note: Demis Hassabis moves to chair; Koray Kavukcuoglu becomes SVP running the lab. Company announcement — not an independent autopsy of Gemini delays.
